create.name: Ashtanga Yoga Luzern
create.bio:
Ashtanga Yoga Luzern teaches the Ashtanga method in its traditional form in central Lucerne, and describes itself as the only school doing so in central Switzerland. It is led by Martyna Syguda, who began practising yoga on her own at twelve, met Ashtanga through Przemek Nadolny while studying psychology in Warsaw, and then spent around two years in all in Mysore over repeated visits, studying the first two series with Sharath Jois as well as with senior teachers such as Rolf Naujokat. She was authorised to teach both series in 2014, joined Sharath's teachers' course in 2016, and has assisted Petri Räisänen at his retreats since meeting him in 2015.

Classes are small and held in a renovated studio on Weggisgasse. In the Mysore sessions every student learns the sequence individually, arriving at any point within the class time, with instruction and adjustments in English, German or Polish; led classes at three levels take students from the basic standing and seated postures to the full primary series, counted in English. Private lessons can be booked in the studio, and Martyna leads occasional workshops and small retreats in the Swiss countryside. Reduced rates are available for anyone who cannot pay the full fee.

courses.title: Group classes: Mysore and Led I–III
courses.description: Mysore-style sessions open to complete beginners, where the sequence is taught one student at a time, and led classes at three levels, from the basic standing and seated postures to the whole primary series. Places are booked online for each class.

courses.title: Class passes
courses.description: Single classes, five- and ten-class passes and one- or three-month passes for the regular timetable, with a reduced first class for local newcomers. Students who cannot afford the full fee are invited to get in touch.
courses.price: Single class CHF 34; 5x pass CHF 150; 10x pass CHF 280; 1 month pass CHF 180; 3 months pass CHF 500

courses.title: Private classes
courses.description: One-to-one or small-group lessons with Martyna Syguda in the Lucerne studio at a time agreed together; the five-lesson pass includes a written personal practice sequence.
courses.price: 60′ CHF 130; 90′ CHF 160 (+ CHF 20 per additional person); 5x pass CHF 600 / CHF 700
